integration_removed.description:
The Microsoft Teams integration has been removed from __HA_KEEP__.

The [Office 365 Connectors]({url}) used by this integration to send messages to Microsoft Teams have been discontinued by Microsoft and are no longer supported.

To resolve this issue, remove the Microsoft Teams integration configuration from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart __HA_KEEP__.

Once the configuration has been removed and __HA_KEEP__ has restarted, this issue will no longer be shown.
integration_removed.title: Microsoft Teams integration has been removed
